bus.via: Winston Salem(Trans Center) to Asheville, NC

trips.route_note: There is no direct train; the practical public option is a intercity bus (such as Greyhound or FlixBus) from Charlotte to Asheville, which takes about 2.5 to 3 hours, and driving takes about 2 hours via I-40 and I-26.
see: Downtown Asheville and the River Arts District
trips.why: Driving takes about 2h35m via I-40 and I-26, while the bus takes around 5 hours with a transfer in Winston-Salem and no direct train exists.
know: Driving is the most direct option, and a car gives flexibility for visiting spread-out sights like the Blue Ridge Parkway.
Book Biltmore Estate tickets ahead, especially on weekends and in peak autumn season.
Bus times vary between sources (2.5-3h in the route note vs. 5h in the listing), so check schedules before you go.
